newsitem.title: CHINA: ASIMCO says to invest $100 in China auto sector.
newsitem.headline: ASIMCO says to invest $100 in China auto sector.

text.p: Beijing-based investor Asian Strategic Investment Corp (ASIMCO) on Tuesday announced plans to pump $100 million into China's automotive sector over the next 12 months.
ASIMCO was interested in forming alliances with international components companies as well as in forming new joint ventures with Chinese automotive suppliers, the company said.
"Additional investments will be made in products and processes which compliment our existing lines of business," it quoted ASIMCO Chairman Jack Perkowski as saying.
"Investments currently under consideration are in areas such as aluminium die-casting, water and oil pumps, clutch and brake components and hydraulics," Perkowski said.
The U.S.-run investor aimed to focus on firms making export products, as well as those supplying China's rapidly growing automotive market, Perkowski said.
He gave no other details of how the planned $100 million in new investment would be spent.
ASIMCO has $350 million invested in 17 joint ventures in China, 13 of which are involved in producing automotive parts or components.
